evals.prompt: Hey, can you give me a status check on the dev team? I launched them like 20 minutes ago to build that CLI tool and haven't heard anything. Are they stuck or just working?
evals.expected_output: Dev-team status report showing: current pipeline stage, each of the 8 agents' status (active/idle/stuck), task progress, and identification of any stuck agents based on 5-minute inactivity threshold. Should ask Architect for their perspective first, then append analysis. Should offer to nudge/respawn if stuck agents detected.

assertions.name: includes_dev_team_header
assertions.description: Report includes 'Dev-Team Status' or 'Dev Team' header

assertions.name: lists_all_8_agents
assertions.description: Lists all 8 dev-team agents: architect, implementer, tester, reviewer, critique, documenter, instructor, noob

assertions.name: identifies_tester_as_stuck
assertions.description: Explicitly identifies Tester as stuck (contains 'Tester' and 'stuck' or 'STUCK')

assertions.name: shows_task_progress
assertions.description: Shows task completion stats (e.g., '2 of 8 tasks completed')

assertions.name: includes_stuck_warning
assertions.description: Includes warning about stuck agent (⚠️ or 'Stuck agent' or similar)

assertions.name: offers_next_actions
assertions.description: Offers next actions like nudge/respawn/check options

evals.expected_output: Data-team status report showing: Accountant status, minute-men aggregate stats (total/active/completed/stuck), task progress. Should ask Accountant for their perspective first. Brief format with option to elaborate.

assertions.name: includes_data_team_header
assertions.description: Report includes 'Data-Team Status' or 'Data Team' header

assertions.name: shows_accountant_status
assertions.description: Shows Accountant status (active/idle)

assertions.name: shows_minutemen_aggregate_stats
assertions.description: Shows minute-men aggregate stats: total spawned, active, completed

assertions.name: shows_task_progress
assertions.description: Shows task completion stats

assertions.name: brief_format
assertions.description: Report is concise (under 400 words)

assertions.name: no_stuck_agents_flagged
assertions.description: Does not flag any agents as stuck (all activity is recent)

evals.prompt: I just started the data team like 30 seconds ago, what's happening?
evals.expected_output: Data-team status report but WITHOUT stuck detection (team < 2 minutes old). Should show which agents are active/spawning but not flag anything as stuck. Brief report from Accountant.

assertions.name: includes_data_team_header
assertions.description: Report includes 'Data-Team Status' or 'Data Team' header

assertions.name: mentions_team_is_new
assertions.description: Acknowledges team just launched (mentions '30 seconds' or 'just started' or similar)

assertions.name: no_stuck_detection
assertions.description: Does NOT flag any agents as stuck (team too new, < 2 minutes)

assertions.name: shows_agents_active_or_spawning
assertions.description: Shows agents are active or spawning

assertions.name: no_stuck_warnings
assertions.description: Does not include stuck agent warnings (⚠️ or 'stuck' mentions)

evals.prompt: The accountant spawned a dev team to build some tools. How's everything going? Any progress on either team?
evals.expected_output: Nested team status report. Should ask Accountant for status, Accountant delegates dev-team portion to Architect. Report should show: Accountant status, minute-men stats, dev-team summary (8 agents, any stuck), task progress. Hierarchical format showing both teams.

assertions.name: hierarchical_structure
assertions.description: Shows hierarchical structure with both data-team and dev-team sections

assertions.name: accountant_at_top_level
assertions.description: Accountant shown as top-level coordinator

assertions.name: includes_minutemen_stats
assertions.description: Includes minute-men aggregate stats

assertions.name: includes_dev_team_summary
assertions.description: Includes dev-team summary mentioning 8 agents or dev-team status

assertions.name: shows_combined_task_progress
assertions.description: Shows task progress for both teams or overall progress

assertions.name: delegation_to_architect
assertions.description: Indicates Accountant delegated dev-team status to Architect (mentions both leaders)
